title: From Perception to Prediction and Intervention: Benchmarking Proactive Video Assistants in Real-Life Scenarios
abstract: arXiv:2610.21568v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: Recent multimodal large language models have advanced video understanding, but existing benchmarks mainly evaluate whether models can interpret observed visual content. In real-world scenarios, assistants must additionally anticipate what assistance is needed and decide when to provide it. To address this gap, we introduce \textsc{P$^3$IBench}, a benchmark for proactive video understanding in real-life streaming scenarios. It evaluates three complementary capabilities: daily perception, risk prediction and intervention. We benchmark 12 representative open-source and proprietary video-language models, including streaming and adapted non-streaming systems. Our evaluation shows that current models struggle to make well-calibrated response decisions. Finally, we construct additional proactive training data and train \textsc{P$^3$I-Assistant-4B}, achieving improvements on several tasks, though gains remain uneven across capabilities. Together

translated_title: 从感知到预测与干预：在真实生活场景中评测主动式视频助手
translated_abstract: 近期多模态大语言模型在视频理解方面取得了进展，但现有的基准测试主要评估模型能否解读观察到的视觉内容。在真实世界场景中，助手还需要预判需要何种帮助，并决定何时提供帮助。为填补这一空白，我们引入了P³IBench，这是一个面向真实生活流媒体场景的主动式视频理解基准。它评估三种互补的能力：日常感知、风险预测与干预。我们对12个具有代表性的开源和专有视频语言模型进行了基准测试，其中包括流式系统和经过适配的非流式系统。我们的评估表明，当前模型难以做出校准良好的响应决策。最后，我们构建了额外的主动式训练数据并训练了P³I-Assistant-4B模型，在若干任务上取得了提升，但各能力之间的增益仍不均衡。
tldr: 该论文提出了面向真实生活流媒体场景的主动式视频理解基准P³IBench，用于评测模型的日常感知、风险预测与干预三项能力，发现现有模型在响应决策校准方面存在不足，并构建主动式训练数据训练出P³I-Assistant-4B模型，在多项任务上取得提升。
en_tdlr: This paper introduces P³IBench, a benchmark for proactive video understanding in real-life streaming scenarios that evaluates daily perception, risk prediction, and intervention, revealing that current video-language models struggle with well-calibrated response decisions, and trains P³I-Assistant-4B on newly constructed proactive data to achieve improvements on several tasks.
